sentence_stem: Although the report was written in dense jargon,
correct_completion: its central argument was nonetheless accessible to ordinary readers.
full_sentence: Although the report was written in dense jargon, its central argument was nonetheless accessible to ordinary readers.
acceptable_variants: its central argument could still be followed by ordinary readers.
the core idea nevertheless reached a general audience.

options.text: so its central argument was easy for everyone to miss.

options.text: and the glossary was printed in a separate volume.
options.why_wrong: This adds an unrelated detail and provides no contrast with the difficulty of the jargon.

explanation: After 'although', the clause must contrast with the difficulty of the register, so the main clause shows that the meaning was still clear.
